nodes.label: AIR Dialect
nodes.description: Architecture-independent MLIR dialect defining a three-level execution hierarchy (launch/segment/herd) with explicit memory hierarchy and async data movement.

nodes.label: air.launch
nodes.description: Outermost hierarchy level; groups co-resident work with may-be-parallel semantics across iteration space. Cannot carry concurrency list.

nodes.label: air.segment
nodes.description: Intermediate hierarchy level; physically contiguous grouping of PEs with shared on-device memory (L2). All iteration space instances run with overlapping lifetimes (always-concurrent).

nodes.label: air.herd
nodes.description: Innermost hierarchy level; 1D or 2D array of PEs executing same body in data-parallel fashion. Always-parallel semantics.

nodes.label: air.dma_memcpy_nd
nodes.description: Asynchronous N-dimensional strided bulk copy between memrefs at any memory level. Direction inferred from address spaces.

nodes.label: air.channel / air.channel.put / air.channel.get
nodes.description: Point-to-point or broadcast communication channels decoupling producers from consumers. Supports dma_stream, dma_packet, and cascade types.

nodes.label: air.execute
nodes.description: Wraps sequential computation in an async region, producing an !air.token on completion.

nodes.label: air.wait_all
nodes.description: Join node: takes variadic !air.token values and produces a single token ready when all inputs are ready.

nodes.label: !air.token
nodes.description: Single MLIR type for all token kinds (dependency, affinity, concurrency). Kind determined by which attribute list the token appears in at consumer.

nodes.label: AIR Memory Hierarchy
nodes.description: Three-level memory: L3 (space 0, system/DDR), L2 (space 1, segment-shared), L1 (space 2, per-PE scratchpad). Cross-level movement must be explicit.

nodes.label: Dependency Token
nodes.description: Token consumed in dependency attribute list; op waits for all listed tokens before beginning. Establishes happens-before ordering.

nodes.label: Affinity Token
nodes.description: Token consumed in affinity attribute list; all ops sharing same token are placed on same hardware partition and execute sequentially.

nodes.label: Concurrency Token
nodes.description: Token consumed in concurrency attribute list; all ops sharing same token must have overlapping execution lifetimes with distinct resource sets.

nodes.label: NPU (AIE) Backend
nodes.description: Maps AIR hierarchy to AMD Versal AI Engine / Ryzen AI NPU: launch->device dispatch, segment->tile rectangle+memtiles, herd->single compute tile.

nodes.label: GPU (ROCDL/HIP) Backend
nodes.description: Maps AIR hierarchy to AMD GPU: launch->gpu.launch grid, segment->workgroup/thread block, herd->thread block dimensions.

nodes.label: air-to-rocdl pass
nodes.description: Flattens air.launch/segment/herd into gpu.launch, converts L1/L2 allocations to workgroup/private attributions, lowers DMA to SCF loops.

nodes.label: air-collapse-herd pass
nodes.description: Reshapes herd iteration space (e.g., collapses 2D to 1D) subject to cascade and placement constraints. Accepts max-col-size option.

nodes.label: Double Buffering (Ping-Pong)
nodes.description: Technique overlapping DMA and compute across loop iterations using pipeline depth D=2 with separate iter_args for prefetch and compute tokens.

nodes.label: Co-residency Guarantee
nodes.description: All air.segment operations within a launch body are guaranteed to be co-resident on device when execution begins, ensuring bounded resource footprint.

nodes.label: XCD (Accelerator Complex Die) Mapping
nodes.description: MI3xx-specific segment mapping where backend-granularity=XCD maps outer segment instances to XCDs for full-device occupancy.

nodes.label: Rationale: Architecture-Independent AIR Dialect
nodes.description: AIR dialect is designed to be architecture-independent at programming-model level so programs can compile to either NPU or GPU backend without changing source IR.

nodes.label: Rationale: May-Be-Parallel Launch Semantics
nodes.description: air.launch uses may-be-parallel (not always-parallel) because GPU dispatches all grid points concurrently while NPU schedules as partitions become available. This asymmetry is intentional.

nodes.label: Rationale: Explicit Cross-Level Data Movement
nodes.description: Direct reads/writes across memory levels are not supported; all cross-level data movement is explicit to enable DMA-based hardware mapping.

nodes.label: Rationale: No Concurrency Token on Launch
nodes.description: air.launch must not carry concurrency list because expressing explicit concurrency bounds would impose ordering constraints contradicting may-be-parallel semantics.

nodes.label: Rationale: IsolatedFromAbove for Hierarchy Levels
nodes.description: Hierarchy levels are IsolatedFromAbove to ensure operands from enclosing scope are passed explicitly as kernel operands, enabling clean hardware partitioning.

nodes.label: Rationale: Static Compile-Time Resource Analysis
nodes.description: Compiler must determine total resource requirements statically so it can verify hardware fit, assign physical resources, and guarantee co-residency without runtime negotiation.
